comment: Parameters 5 and 19, and inputs 1, 3, 7 and 8, have no control on the panel: the trigger mode and its CV, a second gate input and the shape CV are left undrawn, and the release stage borrows the switch the enum calls S_TS, so parameter 19 is never read. They are left untagged. The clock jack is not a trigger: SurgeModuleCommon.hpp:128 raises two to the power of its voltage to set the tempo, so 0V is 120 BPM and each volt doubles it. The output swings plus or minus 5V for a bipolar shape and 0-10V when the unipolar setting is on, so its range follows the shape rather than the jack.
